stem: What is the controlling idea of the article “Counting like the Maya”?

options.label: A
options.text: The Maya people used small symbols including bars and dots to represent digits of different values.

options.label: B
options.text: Mayan math is being used today by preschool students to learn to add and subtract and by older students to solve square-root problems.

options.label: C
options.text: Many people who are descended from the ancient Maya civilization still carry some of their ancestors’ scholarly traditions in the present.

options.label: D
options.text: Mayan math is an ancient system that is so simple and effective that modern descendants of the Maya are using it to learn with great success.
